message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card Uno deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play all your cards and win the round). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn over the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card (e.g., +2, Reverse), treat it as if it had been played by the dealer. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches either:
• the color of the top discard card, or
• the number/symbol of the top discard card.
Special action cards (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four) follow their own rules. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and misses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Same as Wild, but next player also draws four cards and misses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may immediately play it; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: the player who missed UNO must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers count as face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 pts each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 pts each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches 500 points (or another agreed threshold). | --- ### Variations & House Rules | Variation | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Stacking** | Some players allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards (i.e., a +2 can be countered with another +2, etc.). | | **No Challenge** | In casual play, players may not challenge a Wild Draw Four. | | **Custom Decks** | Uno has many themed decks (e.g., Disney, Marvel). Rules stay the same unless specified. | | **Card Count** | Some groups play with fewer cards per player (e.g., 5 instead of 7). | | **Penalty for Not Saying UNO** | Instead of drawing two cards, some house rules require the player to draw four. | Feel free to tweak any rule to suit your group—Uno is meant to be fun and flexible!
